criteria.reasoning: Clear goal, four quantified objectives, users (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) tied to needs, and literature cited [1]-[6]. Objectives explicitly traced to user needs. Only minor gap: no explicit top-level requirements table, but essentially complete.

criteria.reasoning: Hand calculations verified correct (a=6978 km, T=5801 s, i=97.8° SSO, 24.2° track shift), STK tutorials done, scenario set up, and results interpreted with a design trade identified. Strong progress with interpretation.

technical_issues.issue: Ground-track shift quoted at equator only; swath/coverage analysis ignores latitude dependence and cloud constraints on weekly revisit, though this is acknowledged as an open trade.
10 m GSD for colour-based bleaching detection from a 600 km orbit implies a demanding payload not yet addressed; acceptable at this stage.

overall: Excellent preliminary report: well-justified Australian reef-monitoring mission with quantified objectives, a robust Gantt plan with contingencies, correct hand calculations, and clear professional presentation. On track for the full assignment.
